description: Add people's feedback to a request. The request's Evidence then shows how many people said it, and when it ships, the people who asked to hear back are told. A request merged into another sends the feedback to the one it was merged into. Up to 50 feedback ids from list_feedback. MANAGER+ required. Refused when the request's title or description repeats what someone wrote in that feedback.

feedback.description: Feedback ids (uuid) from list_feedback, up to 50

ticketId.description: Ticket id (uuid): list_requests / get_request return these
